name: YourPetPass Pet Travel Rules Change Ledger
scope: Owner-accompanied, non-commercial dog travel for current priority jurisdictions unless otherwise stated.

source_policy.country_entry_rules: Destination-government sources control country entry, import, quarantine, permit, treatment, vaccination, customs and border rules.
source_policy.origin_export_or_return_rules: Origin-country government sources support export, endorsement, disease-status and return requirements.
source_policy.airline_rules: Airlines are used only for their own carriage, cabin, cargo, service-animal, aircraft, booking and route restrictions.
source_policy.excluded_sources: Third-party blogs, mass directories, paid link schemes and relocation summaries are not controlling sources.

entries.rule_field: New World screwworm inspection certificate for pet dogs
entries.old_value: No routine health certificate for U.S.-origin dogs; SENASICA inspection on arrival.
entries.proposed_new_value: Dogs moving from the United States to Mexico must carry a New World screwworm inspection certificate issued no more than five days before Mexico entry.
entries.recommended_action: Keep urgent disease-control flag active and validate certificate issue date against actual entry date.

entries.rule_field: Screwworm-freedom certification for dogs entering the United States
entries.old_value: CDC Dog Import Form and ordinary CDC pathway where applicable.
entries.proposed_new_value: Dogs entering the United States from Mexico still need the applicable screwworm-freedom certification in addition to CDC dog-import requirements.
entries.recommended_action: Keep this directional rule separate from U.S.-to-Mexico certificate rules.

entries.old_value: New certificate framework effective in 2026; transition required date-versioning.
entries.proposed_new_value: Keep certificate logic versioned by issue date, travel date and destination. Legacy certificate acceptance remains date-limited under EU transition rules.
entries.recommended_action: Keep airport, arrival-time, transit and certificate-date validation active.

entries.affected_jurisdiction: Colombia or Thailand to United States
entries.old_value: Colombia and Thailand treated as CDC high-risk countries.
entries.proposed_new_value: Keep high-risk pathway active. U.S. return requirements depend on six-month travel history and vaccination origin.
entries.recommended_action: Require six-month country history, vaccination origin, CDC forms, titer/quarantine pathway where applicable and arrival airport.

entries.old_value: United States excluding Guam and Hawaii handled as Group 3 origin.
entries.proposed_new_value: Keep long-lead Group 3 dog-import pathway, including RNATT sequencing, import permit and quarantine requirements.
entries.recommended_action: Keep manual planning and route-specific checks for RNATT, identity verification, permits, quarantine, routing and transit.
